kazaul_masters_met_but_no_quest_started_.m: If you ever leave while I am talking to you again, I will end your life. Understood?

kazaul_masters_not_met_10.m:
[While pointing its finger in your direction.]
You! How did you get past our army?

kazaul_masters_not_met_20.m: We are "masters", not "bosses". And yes, there are five of us.

kazaul_masters_not_met_30.m: Well, currently there are only four of us masters. We are not complete.
r: "Complete"? What is that supposed to mean?

masters_send_to_thalen_10.m:
[The Master's hollow eyes flare briefly with dim blue fire.]
You hold the Ritual of Five Aspects, mortal. But its meaning lies beyond your grasp. Only Thalen, our brother of Knowledge, can speak the words. Seek him where the thoughts of the dead still linger.
r: Thalen? What will he do with it?

masters_send_to_thalen_20.m: He will guide your unlearned hands. He alone can draw the pattern that binds the Five. Without him, the ritual is only ink on lost parchment.

morvath_after_fifth_master.m: The Fifth breathes again. The world will tremble...as it once did.

morvath_after_fifth_master_narrator.m: A slow rumble of laughter escapes the Master's skeletal chest.

morvath_intro.m: You reek of intrusion, mortal. The stench of the living offends this place.
r: I mean no harm. Who...what are you?

morvath_intro_20.m: I am Morvath, the Kazaul master of wrath.

morvath_intro_narrator.m: The cavern trembles with wrath. A heavy voice fills your mind.

the_fifth_master_10.m:
[The air grows heavy as the master studies you.]
You are bold to walk here. Perhaps bold enough to be of use. One of our own is missing. The fifth master, Anavrin, lies silent. The Ritual of Five Aspects was taken from us long ago. Without it, Anavrin cannot rise, and we cannot restore balance.
r: You want me to find this ritual?

the_fifth_master_20.m: Yes. The Ritual of Five Aspects lies lost among your kind. Long ago, a mortal scribe named Varnel served the Kazaul, writing our words into form. But when fear took him, he fled with the ritual and hid among your people. Bring it back to us, and the Rift will be sealed forever. Fail, and your world will wither like ours.
r: I do not trust you, but I will look.

the_fifth_master_accept.m:
[The master's eyes flare with dim light.]
Then go, mortal. Seek the lost ritual. In the ruins of your kind lies our key to completion. Return only when it is found.

fifth_master.10: In Undertell, the Kazaul Masters spoke to me. They claimed a forgotten ritual could seal the Rift once and for all.
fifth_master.20: They told me that this ritual was stolen long ago by a Lethgar named Varnel, who fled Undertell with it. I agreed to recover it, believing it might save Dhayavar.
fifth_master.30: In the upper dormitory tunnels of Undertell, I met the ghost of a miner who remembered Varnel. The ghost said Varnel escaped through the northern caverns and headed east toward the Sutdover River. Could he have meant Sullengard?
fifth_master.40: I traveled to Sullengard and spoke with Kealwea, the local priest. He recalled a relic matching my description once being sent to the Shadow church library in Remgard.
fifth_master.50: In Remgard's church basement, I spoke with Gwendolyn, the librarian. She said she knew nothing of any ritual but allowed me to search the shelves myself.
fifth_master.55: I discovered a small, locked box hidden behind the books. Its surface was etched with strange curling runes and old scorch marks. The box refused to open.
fifth_master.58: After I asked Gwendolyn about the locked box that I found, she directed me to speak with Skylenar upstairs.
fifth_master.60: Skylenar told me the box was an ancient relic, sealed by dragonkind and said to open only to a dragon's claw.
fifth_master.65: Skylenar mentioned that some old Shadow tales spoke of ash-covered scales found deep within Undertell, hinting that one such beast may once have lived there.
fifth_master.70: In the glowing white house basement, I talked to Falkour the dragon. When I showed him the locked box, he recognized it as a relic once held by Varnel.
fifth_master.72: Falkour gifted me one of his claws, saying it could break the seal, and warned me to use it only for that purpose. Time to find a safe place in this basement to open the box.
fifth_master.75: Using Falkour's claw, I unlocked the ancient box. Inside were the five pages of the Kazaul ritual the Masters desired.
fifth_master.78: The Master that I brought "The Five Aspects" ritual to sent me to talk to Thalen, the Master of Knowledge.
fifth_master.80: I returned the ritual to Thalen. He told me to meet the "lesser kin" at Anavrin's shrine to perform the ceremony.
fifth_master.85: As the ritual completed, the Masters revealed their true intent. The rite was not to seal the Rift but to awaken the Fifth Master, whose power might reopen it. They told me the Shadow itself serves Kazaul. Their words left me doubtful, unsure whether I had been deceived or warned.
fifth_master.90: I left Undertell uncertain of what to believe. If what the Masters said is true, the Shadow may not be what it seems. Still, doubt lingers like smoke after the forge cools.
